title: Self-scorecard
goal: Compute and persist the framework's own scorecard: admit self-sensing under declared roles, read one canonical readings store, declare the sensor inputs a CLI-shaped repository needs, author the specification substrate the spec sensors measure, reconcile the governance ledger sensors with second-generation decision records, and close with a committed scorecard in which every scoreable cell is PASS.

owner_effects.description: Repoint DEVAI_PROCESS_CONTROL_COMMIT to the merged head of R-0202 so the Pages provenance change is the approved process control before the next release.

architect.use_for: orchestration, contracts, schemas, policy, decision records

worker-high.use_for: implementation across several modules, sensor and authority changes, tests of runtime semantics

clerk.use_for: mechanical edits, regeneration, dependency bumps, formatting

escalation.trigger: one failed iteration, a blocked report, or a time budget exceeded without a pull request

rounds.title: Governance for self-sensing
rounds.goal: The self-dogfood policy admits sensing and recording under declared roles, the scorecard reads one canonical readings store, and the N/A ledger states the scoreable cell count once.

tasks.title: Admit sense run, sense record, and audit observe in the self-dogfood policy
deliverables: The policy names sense run with effect read for every role, sense record and audit observe with effect harness-write for the inspector only, and keeps remote-write forbidden in every row.
The schema rejects a row that admits sense record or audit observe with any effect other than harness-write.
The self-dogfood service refuses sense run --write from every role except the inspector and refuses any sense action that names --publish.
Unit tests cover admission, refusal, and the fail-closed remainder for the three actions.

waves.title: Canonical readings store and N/A ledger

tasks.title: Read one readings store from the scorecard facade and record F4:T5 in the N/A ledger
deliverables: audit scorecard reads readings through the loop input resolver, so the facade and the Auditor see the same store under .devai/state/sensor-readings.

The law N/A ledger lists F4:T5 with its Article 5 reason, the adopter default and the materialized copy carry the same entry, and the degenerate set in the loop is derived from the ledger rather than duplicated.
The scorecard theory page states the scoreable cell count for DEVAI as 43 and explains the two N/A cells.
Tests prove that a reading persisted through sense record is visible to audit scorecard and that the ledger is the only source of N/A cells.

rounds.title: Sensor inputs for the framework repository
rounds.goal: Every read-effect sensor that failed or reported review for a missing input runs against DEVAI with inputs declared in adopter configuration, and the harness sensors may call the GitHub CLI read-only.

tasks.title: Declare the sensor inputs schema and the DEVAI inputs file
deliverables: A schema mapping a sensor kind to its declared inputs: test roots, ADR directory, invariants directory, coverage path, effects tsconfig path, typecheck argv, performance script name.

DEVAI's own file declaring packages/*/tests and tests as test roots, law/adr as the ADR directory, the RC coverage summary path, tests/config/tsconfig.effects.json, the workspace typecheck argv, and test:perf.
An adopter default with the same shape and empty declarations.
The schema catalogued as a source-only schema and documented for adopters.

tasks.title: Prove that declared inputs are honored and undeclared inputs are refused
deliverables: Failing tests for each inspector acceptance item of ADR-SCR-0005: a declared test root is walked, a declared ADR directory is counted, a declared coverage path is read, a declared effects tsconfig is used, an undeclared key is refused with a structured error, and a declared path outside the repository is refused.
A contract test that DEVAI's own sensor-inputs.json validates and names only registered sensor kinds.

tasks.title: Merge declared inputs into sensor runs and honor them in the sensors
deliverables: sense run resolves .devai/config/sensor-inputs.json, validates it, merges it under any explicit --input, and shows the effective inputs in --dry-run.
The test walker, spec depth, coverage depth, effect inference, type check, and perf test sensors consume their declared inputs instead of hardcoded defaults.
All tests from TASK-0222 pass and the sweep dry run lists the effective inputs per member.

waves.title: Read-only GitHub CLI for harness sensors

tasks.title: Admit gh run list as a read-only host process for the harness sensors
deliverables: The authority policy declares gh run list, with a fixed argv shape and --json, as a read-only process the broker admits without a host adapter, the same way preflight probes were admitted.
harness_green_main, harness_performance, and harness_robustness produce readings instead of AUTHORITY_HOST_PROCESS_ADAPTER_REQUIRED.
A test proves that gh with any mutating subcommand is still refused.

tasks.title: Declare plant surfaces and the skipped-reading rule for absent surfaces
deliverables: The sensor inputs schema gains a surfaces declaration: http, database, rbac, and actions, each true or false, with DEVAI declaring only actions.

The scorecard composer ignores skipped readings when a cell has any measured reading, and records a cell with only skipped readings as N/A with the declaration as its reason, never as UNKNOWN or REVIEW.
The theory page and the adopter guide state the rule and the resulting DEVAI grid.

tasks.title: Prove that absent surfaces skip and present surfaces still measure
deliverables: Tests that every inventory and plant sensor emits skipped with the declaration reason when its surface is declared absent, and emits a measured reading when the surface is declared present, using fixtures for both a CLI-shaped and a service-shaped repository.
A contract test that plant_coverage and inventory_coverage measure the action registry when actions is the only declared surface and report pass on a fixture mirroring DEVAI.

tasks.title: Make the inventory and plant sensors honor declared surfaces and measure the action registry
deliverables: Each inventory and plant sensor reads the surfaces declaration, emits skipped with the reason for an absent surface, and emits a review finding when the declaration contradicts what it finds.
plant_coverage and inventory_coverage count action registry entries against their spec links when actions is declared, so F2:T1 and F4:T2 measure DEVAI.
All tests from TASK-0227 pass and the sweep dry run shows the surfaces per member.

tasks.title: Publish Pages with the provenance message the site drift sensor verifies
deliverables: The Pages publication path records the provenance message docs: publish from <40-hex-sha> so site_drift can verify the published tip, or the sensor reads the provenance the publication path already writes; one of the two, decided by the sensor note.
site_drift reports pass against the currently published site once the next publication lands, and unknown with a precise finding before.

rounds.title: Specification substrate
rounds.goal: The framework's reference signal exists as records: invariants derived from the constitution and accepted decisions, a threat model, a data handling declaration, and performance and robustness targets, each traceable to tests.

tasks.title: Author the invariant records, the threat model, and the target declarations
deliverables: One invariant record per constitutional obligation that a sensor or test can measure, validated by law/schemas/invariant.schema.json, with severity from the readiness-bearing set where the constitution says so.

A threat model naming the trust boundaries the authority broker, the evidence transport, and the release workflow defend, and a data handling declaration stating that the repository stores no personal data.
Performance targets for the check runner, the sweep, and the RC, and robustness targets for the error contract, each with a measurable statement.
Schemas for the three new record kinds, catalogued as source-only.

tasks.title: Prove that every invariant resolves to a test and every target to a sensor
deliverables: A contract test that every invariant id appears in law/trace.json with at least one existing test path, and that every readiness-bearing invariant is referenced by a test.
A contract test that every performance and robustness target names a sensor kind from the registry and a threshold the sensor emits as a metric.
Sensor tests asserting spec_depth, spec_alignment, spec_security_coverage, spec_performance_targets, and spec_robustness_targets read the new records and report pass on a fixture mirroring DEVAI.

tasks.title: Link tests to invariants in the trace and align the spec sensors with the record layout
deliverables: law/trace.json maps every invariant to the tests that observe it; tests gain invariant references where the trace needs them.
The five spec sensors and the two invariant alignment sensors read the record layout from TASK-0231 rather than guessing file names.
All tests from TASK-0232 pass and the sweep dry run shows the spec sensors with their declared inputs.

tasks.title: Link every registered action from a use case so the coverage sensors measure the whole registry
deliverables: Every entry of law/policy/action-registry.json is referenced through refs.actionRefs in a use-case flow under product/use-cases, grouped by the operator journey it belongs to (audit, backlog, release, round tracking, triage).
plant_coverage and inventory_coverage report action_coverage_pct 100 and pass on the repository.

rounds.title: Governance ledger sensors on ADR v2
rounds.goal: The decision record integrity and citation resolution sensors validate the second-generation decision records and report zero findings on main.

tasks.title: Validate decision records against the v2 schema and resolve the five stale citations
deliverables: decision_record_integrity validates each record against law/schemas/adr-v2.schema.json, treats proposed, accepted, rejected, and superseded as the lifecycle, and checks supersession symmetry through the supersedes array alone.

decision_citation_resolution resolves scoped ids; the two legacy numeric ADR citations in the schema examples and the two draft DII identities in the scorecard composer are replaced by resolvable references or removed with a comment naming the replacement.
Both sensors report zero findings on the merged head, proven by a test that runs them against the repository.

rounds.title: Plant and observation hygiene
rounds.goal: The dependency audit is clean, tests are classified so the security, performance, and robustness coverage sensors count them, the largest plant files are within depth thresholds, and the workflows satisfy the harness idiomaticity sensor.

tasks.title: Clear the high-severity audit finding
deliverables: pnpm audit reports zero high or critical findings; moderate findings are listed in the report with their advisories.
The workspace builds and the local full suite passes after the bump.

tasks.title: Classify security, performance, and robustness tests so the coverage sensors count them
deliverables: The three coverage sensors document the classification they count (file name segment or describe prefix) and DEVAI's existing authority, forbidden-action, and error-contract tests carry it.
test_security_coverage, test_performance_coverage, and test_robustness_coverage report pass in the sweep against the merged head.
The testing guide states the classification convention.

tasks.title: Split the plant files above the depth threshold
deliverables: Every file the plant_depth sensor flags is split along existing module seams with no behavior change, and plant_depth reports pass in the sweep.
The local full suite and typecheck pass.

tasks.title: Bring the workflows to the harness coherence and idiomaticity thresholds
deliverables: harness_coherence and harness_idiomaticity report pass: shared setup steps are a composite action, dependency caching is present, and concurrency and permissions blocks are uniform.
The workflow checker keeps every pin and the secret bijection intact.

waves.title: Harness idiomaticity threshold as a declared input

tasks.title: Declare the reusable-workflow threshold of the harness idiomaticity sensor as a sensor input
deliverables: The sensor inputs schema declares minWorkflowsForReusableCheck for harness_idiomaticity; DEVAI declares 5 with its reason on the adopter page; the adopter default leaves it undeclared.
The resolver exposes the key and the adapter passes it to the sensor instead of a hardcoded default; undeclared keeps today's behavior.
Tests prove a declared threshold above the workflow count drops the reusable-workflow signal, and harness_idiomaticity reads pass on the repository together with the composite action from TASK-0254.

tasks.title: Bring the plant depth tail under the pass threshold across every package
deliverables: plant_depth reports pass on the repository: p95 under 500 lines with the generated action registry declared out of the plant as a derived F4 artifact through an excludeGlobs sensor input under ADR-SCR-0005.

Every remaining file at or over 500 lines is split along a seam or has cohesive function bodies extracted into named helpers with no behavior change; public module paths stay stable through re-exports; the source-text pin in live-ledger-workflow.test.ts moves to the new module paths.
The authority broker keeps every admission decision in one module; only pure helpers leave it.

rounds.title: Persist readings and the first scorecard
rounds.goal: The inspector records a full sweep, the Auditor observes the merged head, and the first compliance scorecard for the framework is committed as measured: every cell carries its reading's verdict, N/A comes only from the ledger and from surfaces declared absent, and every non-PASS cell is recorded with its finding as a follow-up.

waves.title: Self-dogfood service wired into the command paths

tasks.title: Wire the self-dogfood service into the sense and audit command paths before readings are recorded
deliverables: On the framework repository, sense run, sense record and audit observe consult the self-dogfood service before acting: a read-effect sense run is admitted for every declared role; sense run with write consent, sense record and audit observe are admitted for the inspector only; any --publish is refused before the policy is parsed; a population with a remote-write member is refused for every role.
The refusals are structured errors with the policy's fail-closed reason, printed on stderr with nothing on stdout, and the dry run shows the decision.
Tests cover each inspector acceptance item of ADR-SCR-0001 through the command paths, not only the service.

tasks.title: Add the test:perf script the sensor inputs declare so the performance cell can be measured
deliverables: A root test:perf script that runs the existing performance observations deterministically with vitest, fast enough for the declared performance targets, with no new dependency and no placeholder test.
perf_test reports pass with script_present true on the repository.

tasks.title: Declare the performance suite invocation as a sensor input and run it under the broker
deliverables: sense run perf_test and sense run type_check report pass on the repository under the broker, with no shell and no package-runner indirection.
The schema admits perf_test.argv, DEVAI declares it, and adopters can keep the legacy scriptName key.
test:sensors and test:cli are green, the frozen doctor digest matches, and the commit range is single-family per commit.

waves.title: Canonical readings store for the consuming sensors

tasks.title: Point the readings-consuming sensors at the canonical sensor-readings store
deliverables: inventory_performance and harness_invariant_alignment read .devai/state/sensor-readings by default, matching the loop resolver, with the explicit overrides preserved.
The sensors suites are green with fixtures on the canonical path; the sensor docs name the canonical store.
On the framework repository with recorded readings, inventory_performance no longer reports "No sensor-readings directory".

tasks.title: Record the sweep, observe the head, and commit the first scorecard
deliverables: Readings for every sweep member recorded through sense record under the inspector role with write consent, plus the build, unit, integration, and e2e readings and the regenerated inventory.

audit observe at the exact merged head writes the scorecard, assessment, and backlog under record/, and audit scorecard --at that head reports the measured verdicts: N/A only from the ledger (F1:T1, F4:T5) and from surfaces declared absent, every other cell carrying its reading, with each non-PASS cell and its finding listed in the campaign guide as a follow-up.
The campaign guide records the scorecard id, the head, and the command sequence; the theory page links the first record.
